official.deadline_note: Applications are open year-round with no closing date published. Applicants receive a link to complete ILSC's Online English Placement Test, which must be completed by the deadline stated in that email, and successful candidates are offered the earliest available date.
official.application_cycle: Rolling year-round intake, with two scholarships per campus available every three sessions
official.status_note: ILSC states that applications are open year-round and that two scholarships per campus are available quarterly for newly arrived refugees within commuting distance of the Adelaide, Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne or Perth campuses; scholarships are also available for the online ILSC Hello courses for those who cannot attend in person.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scholarships cover 11-12 weeks of English language study in groups (General English, Exam Preparation and English for Academic Purposes), all learning materials and resources required for the classes, and administrative fees. No monetary value is published.
benefits: 11-12 weeks of English language study in groups, including General English, Exam Preparation and English for Academic Purposes
All learning materials and resources required for the classes
Free Duolingo Premium account for the duration of the placement, sponsored by Duolingo
Access to multiple free events and clubs on campus
Barista skills development in the Cafe Work Skills course
Other selective courses matched to the participant's interest
eligibility: Hold, or be on a bridging visa for, one of the Australian humanitarian visas 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851 or 866
Be at least 18 years of age at the commencement of studies
Live within commuting distance of the ILSC-Adelaide, ILSC-Brisbane, ILSC-Melbourne, ILSC-Sydney or ILSC-Perth campus
Not have received a Centrelink Relocation Grant
Not have received the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship before
requirements: Provide proof of an Australian humanitarian or the respective bridging visa
Complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test and reach Pre-intermediate or above
Maintain a minimum attendance of 80 per cent during the programme
Accept the scholarship offer within 48 hours, or it is withdrawn and offered to another candidate
Accept that course selections and timetables depend on availability on enrolment and that confirmed start dates cannot be deferred
documents: Proof of Australian humanitarian or respective bridging visa
Completed free ILSC Online English Placement Test result showing Pre-intermediate or above
selection_criteria: Selected by a committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools
Successful candidates are offered the scholarship based on the earliest available date and their selected preference
ILSC states it does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, national origin, disability, age, gender, sexual orientation or religion

application_method: Submit the application through ILSC's Humanitarian Scholarship application page

Await selection by the committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools

official.application_route: Apply online through ILSC's Humanitarian Scholarship application page; selection is by a committee of ILSC Australia staff and teachers.
official.study_mode: In-person group classes on campus (8:30am-1pm, 1:15pm-5:15pm or 5:30-9:30pm) or online ILSC Hello classes (10am-2pm AEST)
official.citizenship_residency: Refugees living in Australia on one of the listed humanitarian or bridging visas, within commuting distance of an ILSC Australian campus or studying online
official.international_eligibility: Not an international study award - it is for refugees already living in Australia on the listed humanitarian or bridging visas
official.duration: Three sessions of four weeks each, except in December, totalling 11-12 weeks of English study
official.description: The ILSC Humanitarian scholarship is designed to support refugees who are facing language barriers to accessing tertiary education or employment in Australia, providing three sessions of English language study, learning materials and administrative fees.
official.program_type: Private education provider scholarship (refugees and asylum seekers on Australian humanitarian visas)
official.english_requirement: Applicants must complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test and be at Pre-intermediate level or above, which is required for eligibility.

verification.notes: Read live on 2026-10-10 from ILSC's own Humanitarian Scholarship page. Confirmed the three-session structure of 11-12 weeks, the covered items (tuition, materials, administrative fees), the Duolingo Premium sponsorship, the humanitarian visa subclass list, the 18+ age rule, the commuting-distance rule across the five Australian campuses, the year-round application window, the 80% attendance requirement and the 48-hour offer acceptance rule. No monetary value is published, so funding_amount is null. Note the live page also offers scholarships for the online ILSC Hello courses for applicants who cannot attend in person, which was not in the catalogue record.

applicant_utility.summary: This award exists to break the English barrier that blocks newly arrived refugees from tertiary study or work in Australia, and it covers tuition, materials and administrative fees for 11-12 weeks of classes with no cash value attached. Only two scholarships per campus are released every three sessions, so competition is tight at each campus even though applications are accepted all year. You will be placed by placement test, not by prior qualification, and the practical trap is the 48-hour window: once an offer email arrives you must accept it within two days or the place goes to someone else. If you cannot travel to a campus, ask about the online ILSC Hello option, since the page now explicitly extends scholarships to those courses.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Refugees aged 18 or over living near Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney or Perth, or able to study online, who need funded English to unlock further study or employment.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your visa is one of the listed humanitarian subclasses (200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851, 866) or the relevant bridging visa, and have the evidence ready
Confirm you have never held the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship before and have not received a Centrelink Relocation Grant
Submit the online application, then watch for the placement test link email and complete it before the stated deadline
Keep your inbox free around the offer stage so you can accept within 48 hours
Check that you can commit to 80% attendance across the three sessions and to a start date that cannot be deferred
common_rejection_risks: Holding a visa subclass that is not on the published list, which rules out eligibility entirely
Having previously received the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship, or a Centrelink Relocation Grant, both of which are disqualifying
Missing the placement test deadline buried in the notification email, which stalls the application
Missing the 48-hour offer acceptance window and losing the place to another candidate
Being under 18 at the commencement of studies
document_audit: Visa evidence is the gatekeeper: the grant letter, ImmiCard or bridging visa notice must clearly match the subclass numbers ILSC lists, so keep it current and legible
There is no academic transcript requirement, so do not delay applying while chasing overseas documents
The placement test link arrives by email with its own deadline, so use an email address you check daily
alerts: Two scholarships per campus every three sessions means a campus can run out of places for months at a time
The offer must be accepted within 48 hours or it is withdrawn and offered to another candidate
Confirmed start dates cannot be deferred, and course selections and timetables depend on availability at enrolment
Attendance below 80% breaches the terms, and the scholarship cannot be exchanged for cash
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the online application on ILSC's Humanitarian Scholarship page, complete the placement test from the emailed link before its deadline, then wait for committee selection and accept any offer within 48 hours.
